title: Player Profile Viewer
description: Browse detailed player profiles directly ingame. View skin history, cape collections, name changes and more.
body:
Player Profile Viewer

The Player Profile Viewer allows you to see a players profile directly from your Minecraft client. Whether you want to see a friend's skin history or access official capes they've owned, you can do so without leaving Minecraft or searching the internet.

Core Features

⏱ History Lookup

You can look up any player's entire history instantaneously. This will include their full UUID, previous usernames used, all skins ever worn, and all official capes associated with that account (activities recorded from the time the player is added to the database).

🌐 Live Server Overview

View all players currently online across your server within one convenient location. This feature includes a clean grid listing names and a quick filter option when searching player's names.

★ Your Favorite People's System

Pin players you care about to your favorites list for quick access to their profile.

Customization and Performance

  • Custom Key Bindings - (default key = K) - Instant open of the database.
  • Live Filtering - Instant filtering of specific players that may be located on packed servers with real time filtering.
  • Extremely Lightweight - Constructed to allow you to "not see it". The mod is designed to run in the background.

It is important to understand that currently, there are approximately 52 million Minecraft users registered in the dripleaf database (as of April 2026), with every user being updated at least once every 3 days, which makes the dripleaf database one of the most updated among all the available Minecraft databases. Tens of thousands of new players added daily. Unfortunately, any information on a user account prior to its initial addition to the database (whether found by dripleaf or through a search of their username or UUID) cannot be retrieved. Data collection begins only after the very first search or registration on dripleaf.
